title: minuartia verna subsp. kabylica
intro: Minuartia verna subsp. kabylica, commonly known as Alpine Spring Pygmy-weed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Minuartia verna subsp. kabylica are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites present in its leaves and roots.
